verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents API Access Tokens that grant access to resources such as CKS clusters and VPCs, plus kubeconfigs generated for a specific cluster. It also lets you exchange an API token for temporary AI Object Storage credentials whose access can be restricted by bucket policies, including group-based access control. Together these give some building-block least-privilege controls, but nothing shows the API tokens themselves can be scoped to limited permissions or resources for an agent. missing for 10: documented per-token permission scopes or roles, service-account or non-human identities for agents, token expiry and rotation controls for API tokens, independent or hands-on corroboration.
